description: Offline finish palette for the complete faceted furniture catalogue. Selectable wood uses exact craft_materials source swatches. The three approved starter pieces are retained byte-for-byte.

crude_workbench.description: One axe-hewn trunk section. Broad bark planes, flared roots and a cut working face; no fitted joinery.

log_bridge.description: Four whole bark-covered trunks laid bank to bank on rough cross logs. Uneven axe-cut ends; no planks, rails or fitted joinery. Log crowns meet the existing Y0 walking plane; buried tails avoid bank z-fighting.
